## Job history

- Real Anvil (Oct 2021 sacct, 14021 rows -> 3762 jobs; step rows aggregated): kept **2078** jobs. Dropped: 1 root/no-user job, 1879 RCAC `testpilot-*` acceptance-test jobs sampled out (kept a deterministic 25% so the mix stays realistic but does not swamp the labs). OnDemand/Jupyter/RStudio sessions are kept (they are the realistic low-efficiency tail).
- Dates shifted +1834 days (262 weeks): history runs 2026-10-02 .. 2026-11-09, weekday and local (ET) hour preserved, then converted to UTC. Slurm JobIDs offset by +13,800,000 (ids `anvil-138xxxxx`).
- Privacy: users -> `user_001..user_031` (rank of sha256), job names only from a generic allowlist (`testpilot-X` -> `bench-X`; OnDemand -> `ood-*`; anything else -> `<workload>-NNNN`), no UID/GID/SubmitLine/WorkDir/StdOut/paths. Accounts: <anvil-acct-1> -> lab-climate (`ees250031`), <anvil-acct-2> -> lab-chem (`che250114`), <anvil-acct-3> -> lab-cv (`cis250417`), RCAC staff users spread over labs; `-gpu` suffix for GPU jobs. Node names (a016, g011) kept (public hardware names).
- Metrics: cpuEfficiency = TotalCPU/(Elapsed*AllocCPUS); memEfficiency = max step MaxRSS (or TRESUsageInTot mem) / AllocTRES mem; costUnits = Anvil SUs: core-hours (shared: max(cores, mem/2 GB)), highmem x4, GPU queues at the ACCESS exchange rate (67.308 SU per A100 GPU-hour, 133.342 per H100).
- Synthetic history: **1664** jobs 2026-07-20 .. 2026-11-18 across gilbreth/gautschi/anvil/negishi/bell/aws, weekday+daytime pattern, pre-deadline spikes, bimodal gpuUtilAvg (wasteful mode per lab), state mix with TIMEOUT/FAILED/OOM/CANCELLED and PREEMPTED on preemptible QOS; Bell jobs stop before 2026-10-29; Gautschi ai jobs before 2026-11-02 may have >4-day limits.
- Jobs by cluster: {'gautschi': 661, 'gilbreth': 675, 'negishi': 72, 'bell': 56, 'anvil': 2227, 'aws-p4d': 64}; by state: {'COMPLETED': 2559, 'CANCELLED': 323, 'FAILED': 463, 'PREEMPTED': 40, 'TIMEOUT': 305, 'OUT_OF_MEMORY': 52, 'RUNNING': 11, 'PENDING': 2}.

## Cost convention (shared with backend)

- GPU partitions: costUnits = allocGpus x hours x Partition.chargeFactor; CPU partitions: allocCpus x hours x chargeFactor; `aws-p4d` (USD): GPU-hours x GpuType.costPerGpuHourUsd x chargeFactor. costUsd = costUnits x ComputeCluster.usdPerUnit. Units: anvil SU (ACCESS credits, $0.01 est.), gilbreth A100-40-equivalent GPU-hour ($1.00 est.), gautschi H100 GPU-hour ($2.00 est.; CPU core-hour = 0.005), negishi/bell core-hour SU ($0.01 est.), aws USD. All RCAC USD rates are estimates (RCAC prices are login-only).
- RunRequest.estGpuHours is in A100-40GB-equivalent GPU-hours (duration = estGpuHours / (gpus x relativeThroughput)).

- REJECTED: `RR-1010` (lab-bio HELIX to AWS -> EXPORT_CONTROL fail), `RR-1011` (lab-ag, AWS credits >= 95% -> L-09 + U-01 fail).
